mapper.insert: insert into pev_report (record_info, report_user, report_dtm, irb, rid) values (#{recordInfo}, #{stfNo}, now(), #{irb}, #{rid})

insert into pev_report_detail values
(#{reportId}, ${index} + 1, #{item.id}, #{item.parentId}, #{item.report}, 'N', null, null)
insert into pev_chart_err (stf_no, irb, rid, target_record, process_yn, load_dtm) values (#{stfNo}, #{irb}, #{rid}, #{targetRecord}, 'N', now())
mapper.select: select row_number() over (order by a.report_id) as rowNum, a.report_id as reportId, a.report_user as reportUser, a.irb as irb, a.rid as rid, a.record_info as recordInfo, to_char(a.report_dtm, 'YYYY-MM-DD hh24:mi:ss') as reportDtm, case when (select count(*) from pev_report_detail z where z.report_id = a.report_id and process_dtm is null) > 0 then 'N' else 'Y' end as processYn, (select count(*) from pev_report_detail z where z.report_id = a.report_id) as allCount, (select count(*) from pev_report_detail z where z.report_id = a.report_id and process_yn = 'Y') as processCount from pev_report a where 1=1 upper(report_user) = upper(#{stfNo}) order by a.report_dtm desc

select a.value_seq as valueSeq, a.value_id as valueId, a.value_parent_id as parentId, a.report_text as reportText, a.process_yn as processYn, a.process_text as processText, to_char(a.process_dtm, 'YYYY-MM-DD hh24:mi:ss') as processDtm from pev_report_detail a where a.report_id = #{reportId} order by value_seq

select row_number() over (order by err_id) as rowNum, err_id as errId, stf_no as stfNo, irb as irb, rid as rid, target_record as targetRecord, to_char(load_dtm, 'YYYY-MM-DD hh24:mi:ss') as loadDtm, process_yn as processYn, case when process_dtm is null then '처리 전' else to_char(process_dtm, 'YYYY-MM-DD hh24:mi:ss') end as processDtm from pev_chart_err where 1=1 upper(report_user) = upper(#{stfNo}) order by load_dtm desc
mapper.update: update pev_chart_err set process_yn = 'Y', process_dtm = now() where err_id = #{errId}
mapper.select: select row_number() over (order by login_dtm) as rowNum, stf_no as stfNo, stf_nm as stfNm, dept_cd as deptCd, dept_nm as deptNm, auth_cd as authCd, to_char(login_dtm, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') as loginDtm from pev_login_log order by login_dtm desc
